{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check status
print(f'Unique status values: {df["status"].unique()}')

# Check revenue column type and sample
print(f'Revenue dtype: {df["revenue"].dtype}')
print(f'Sample of revenue: {df["revenue"].head().tolist()}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f'Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df["customer_age"] == -1).sum()}')"}
